It includes a cinematic Webpage experience, an interactive Terminal experience, and a live MarkAI conversational assistant grounded in approved portfolio information.

records.title: MarkAI Portfolio Assistant
records.publicText: MarkAI is Mark’s live conversational portfolio assistant on markyoingco.com. It is part of Mark’s solo portfolio platform. The interface uses React and Vite. The public endpoint uses PHP. The language-model provider uses Cloudflare Workers AI with the selected model @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b. Answers are grounded in approved portfolio information. PromptBuilder selects relevant approved context, ProviderResponseValidator checks generated answers, and deterministic fallback answers remain available when the provider is disabled, rate-limited, or unavailable. Provider calls use HTTPS with certificate and hostname verification, with no retries and no streaming. Private configuration remains outside the public web root. Anonymous session usage limits protect the public endpoint and store usage metadata only, not questions or answers. The initial live release does not include an owner question-history dashboard. MarkAI is live and actively maintained; it may continue receiving bug fixes, testing, design refinement, and approved knowledge expansion.
records.shortText: Live, actively maintained React/Vite and PHP portfolio assistant using Cloudflare Workers AI, approved knowledge, validation, fallback, privacy protections, and rate limiting.

records.title: Abacus Senior Design Capstone
records.publicText: Abacus is a team senior design web platform used for the Wisconsin-Dairyland Programming Competition. Mark’s verified work centered on the Eagle Division full-stack workflow, including messaging APIs, role-aware student and staff chat, inbox behavior, instructions access, routing, persistence, and related UI debugging. The April 15, 2026 live competition used Abacus to support approximately 200–300 high-school students, teachers, judges, and administrators and ran without major server crashes, platform failures, critical bugs, or major lag. Separate contribution and deep-dive records document the exact scope of his work.
